articles.expand: Germany's economy grew 0.2% in Q2, surpassing forecasts amid strong export performance. Year-on-year calendar-adjusted growth accelerated to 0.9% from expected 0.6% slowdown. articles.expand: Australia's consumer price inflation slowed to a four-month low in June on lower fuel prices and underlying inflation remained stable, easing pressure on the central bank for further policy tightening.
